channel.title: Wire — Releases
channel.description: Releases from thirty sources, one digest a day.

item.title: OpenAI GPT-6 Sol and GPT-6 Luna are now generally available on Amazon Bedrock
item.description: Today, AWS announces the general availability of GPT-6 Sol and GPT-6 Luna from OpenAI on Amazon Bedrock. (2 sources: aws, hackernews)

item.title: Claude Opus 5.5 is now available on AWS GovCloud (US)
item.description: AWS GovCloud (US) now offers Claude Opus 5.5, Anthropic’s most capable Opus model yet and, the first of the Claude 5.5 model family, a better collaborator that handles long-running coding and knowledge work, reporting back clearly on what… (2 sources: aws, hackernews)

item.title: Amazon CloudWatch Omni: AI-first observability for agents and applications
item.description: AWS announces the general availability of Amazon CloudWatch Omni, an evolution of Amazon CloudWatch. (1 source: aws)

item.title: Billing Transfer now supports automatic billing group creation for two-level transfers
item.description: AWS Billing Transfer users can now enable the Auto-Billing Transfer Billing Group Creation, a new AWS Billing Conductor preference that eliminates the manual billing group configuration in two-level billing transfer arrangements. (1 source: aws)

item.title: Amazon EMR introduces Long Term Support with Apache Spark 4.1
item.description: Amazon EMR introduces Long Term Support (LTS) releases, starting with emr-spark-8.1.0 and Apache Spark 4.1. With LTS, designated versions of the AWS runtime for Apache Spark receive 36 months of support. (1 source: aws)

item.title: Amazon Route 53 Resolver is now generally available on second-generation AWS Outposts racks
item.description: Amazon Route 53 Resolver is now generally available on second-generation AWS Outposts, providing local, managed recursive DNS resolution directly on your Outpost. (1 source: aws)
